disclosure: Working browser demo · captured interaction states
presentation: An edited, silent sequence of actual browser captures with separate editorial captions. No simulated clicks, live-recording claim, fabricated UI, or speed benchmark.

facts.fixture: Original synthetic receipt with fictional example contacts
facts.facts_source: Completed local browser/export checks and npm test; this single sample does not measure OCR recall or device compatibility.

scenes.title: Inspect what you share.
scenes.caption: An application receipt is useful evidence. Contact details can travel with it.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual workbench hero and upper part of the synthetic receipt
scenes.editorial_fact: ShareProof · A screenshot review and export inspection tool

scenes.title: Start with a fictional receipt.
scenes.caption: The demo uses made-up contact details. The receipt should remain readable after covering them.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual scrolled receipt with readable synthetic contact details
scenes.editorial_fact: Original synthetic sample · no real applicant information

scenes.title: Recognition stays in the browser.
scenes.caption: A bundled English OCR worker searches for email and phone regions. No recognition API receives the image.
scenes.editorial_fact: Real captured progress state · no processing-time claim

scenes.title: Two suggestions. Two decisions.
scenes.caption: The actual scan found two contact candidates. Each needs Cover or Keep visible.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual two OCR results, both pending review
scenes.editorial_fact: Suggestions are review prompts, not a complete privacy scan

scenes.title: An unfinished review blocks export.
scenes.caption: The email is temporarily kept visible. The phone remains undecided, so the PNG cannot be built yet.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual Keep visible email decision with pending phone and blocked export
scenes.editorial_fact: Keep visible is an explicit choice; undecided suggestions block export

scenes.title: Cover the sample contacts.
scenes.caption: Both contact suggestions are now covered with solid, opaque rectangles.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual email and phone covered state

scenes.title: Add what OCR does not find.
scenes.caption: The participant name is covered manually. Drawing, coordinates and Undo keep the owner in control.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual manual name cover with source coordinates
scenes.editorial_fact: Names, addresses and contextual details still need manual review

scenes.title: Review the whole image.
scenes.caption: Three regions are selected. The owner confirms the rest of the receipt before building the export.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual three covers and checked visual-review confirmation
scenes.editorial_fact: The surrounding receipt remains useful and readable

scenes.title: Inspect the file that will leave.
scenes.caption: The final PNG is decoded again. All 27,480 selected pixels match the exact opaque cover color.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual successful PNG round trip and selected-pixel result
scenes.editorial_fact: 1160 × 910 PNG · selected regions only · exact RGBA check

scenes.title: A note tied to these exact bytes.
scenes.caption: SHA-256 identifies the inspected PNG. The note records review facts without recognized contact text or the original filename.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual result hash, chunk details and enabled downloads
scenes.editorial_fact: 90,562 bytes · retained chunks: IHDR / IDAT / IEND

scenes.title: Open the actual downloaded PNG.
scenes.caption: The selected details are covered in the exported file. Useful confirmation details remain visible.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual downloaded PNG opened in the browser
scenes.editorial_fact: The output file, not only the editing preview

scenes.title: Revise, then inspect again.
scenes.caption: Undo removes the manual name cover. A changed image needs fresh visual review and export inspection.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual Undo or cover removal with invalidated result
scenes.editorial_fact: Inspection belongs to a specific version of the file

scenes.title: Keep the promise narrow and visible.
scenes.caption: OCR can miss details. This checks selected covers; it does not certify complete anonymization or redact PDFs.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual how-check-works or scope and limitations panel
scenes.editorial_fact: Local image processing · no image upload request · manual review required

scenes.title: From scope to an inspectable result.
scenes.caption: The six-stage planning pack guided scope, PRD and specification drafts. All 12 core checks pass.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual repository or planning files, with no invented learner reflection
scenes.editorial_fact: ShareProof · review the image, then inspect what you share
